pieces.Text: As a standard action, an imentesh can inflict a warpwave upon any corporeal creature within 100 feet.  The target can resist the warpwave's effects with a DC

Fortitude save.  If the imentesh wishes, it can use this ability as a swift action, but if it does so, it is affected by the warpwave as well unless it resists the effects with its own Fortitude save.  See page 213 for a list of possible effects caused by a warpwave.
